identification: Black painted tin carry case (checker-plate aluminium base liner) containing: a brass pedestal kerosene lamp with a bulbous font, knopped stem and stepped round foot, fitted with a continental (French/German) centre-draught style burner with pierced crown gallery and side wick wheel, no chimney fitted; two loose glass chimneys/globe bases (one with a frosted band); and a pressed brass or copper domed disc that looks like a smoke bell or the lamp's foot weight cover. Early 20th century, European style. Burner make not legible. Cloud scan broadly right, but this is a brass lamp plus parts, not a complete lamp with shade.
